name: smart-wallet-spend
title: Spend
notes:
• At least threshold of members sign; members are verification keys in this version.
• Every spenders script runs as a withdraw-0 and must approve.
• The wallet survives: the only output at wallet_addr is NFT-bearing, with depositors unchanged and the spenders key set fixed.
• The continuation value is a subset of the input's; a spend only removes value.
• Payout outputs elsewhere are unconstrained.
• The reference implementation reads members and threshold from the Settings UTxO; design.typ abstracts the config source.
